summary.question: The customer on service svc365 (10GE between S11 and S17) reports a brief interruption from about t=720 s. What is the cause?

cause_and_place.basis: the six leading hypotheses of the final ledger

Runners-up: S17–S18 shift plus misconnect 0.259; S18–S19 shift plus misconnect 0.259; S19–S21 shift plus misconnect 0.259; margin erosion plus misconnect 0.181; misconnect alone 0.036; none of these 0.003.

No checks were performed, no engineering effort was recorded, and no site visits occurred. No next diagnostic action is specified in the summary.
